summary: Iteration 17 - End-to-end testing of 6 bug fixes (image preservation, mobile text overflow, frozen columns, password toggles, Created On/Updated By columns, text contrast). All backend tests (9/9) and all frontend flows passed. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration17_bug_fixes.py with image preservation, excel-export audit columns, sort_by created_at/updated_at, and audit-field exposure tests. Frontend Playwright tests covered: login password toggle, user-create password toggle, frozen columns + new audit columns on desktop /accounts, sort by Created On (order changes asc/desc), jewellery thumbnails (jewellery-thumb-0-0/0-1/1-0 all rendered), mobile card audit fields, mobile rich-text overflow on ACC000008, CSS token values (--text-muted=#64748B, --text-secondary=#334155).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/accounts.py update_account is now ~140 lines with two model_dump calls (line 165-166): `raw_payload = account.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` and `update_data = {k: v for k, v in account.model_dump().items() if v is not None}`. The second one excludes None values, which means setting a field to null via PUT becomes a no-op silently. Recommend using `exclude_unset=True` as the single source-of-truth and explicitly handling each optional field.
JewelleryItem.images is typed `Optional[List[dict]]` - prefer a typed nested model (JewelleryImage) for image url/id/uploaded_at so frontend/backend contract is enforced via Pydantic.

AccountsPage frozen-cols-table parent container's overflow-x is on a different element than the table itself - in our test page.evaluate scrollLeft of tbl.parentElement returned 0 even after assignment. The actual scroller is likely a different ancestor (.overflow-x-auto wrapper). Frozen columns still work correctly via CSS sticky positioning, but tests targeting horizontal scroll should query the correct scroll container. Not a functional bug.
Login redirect goes to '/' instead of '/dashboard' - minor UX detail, page still loads dashboard via root route. Not a bug, just inconsistent with test contract.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 9 frontend checks passed: login pwd toggle, user pwd toggle, frozen-cols table sticky+z-index, 4 new audit columns headers visible, sort by Created On changes order, jewellery thumb-0-0/0-1/1-0 all rendered, 4 mobile cards show created-on+updated-by, no body horizontal overflow on ACC000008, safe-rich-text containers fit within clientWidth, CSS tokens --text-muted=#64748B, --text-secondary=#334155)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded ACC000007 (id 6a3691297e4c7d2ddc6dcc60, jewellery images 2+1) and ACC000008 (id 6a36933710df5916ef9eec9a, overflow rich text). Image preservation test restored the customer name after edit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 fully tested both backend and frontend for 6 bug fixes. test_iteration17_bug_fixes.py covers image preservation regression (exclude_unset on jewellery_items.images), excel export new headers (Created On / Created By / Updated On / Updated By), and sort_by=created_at|updated_at. All previous iteration tests (1-16) still work; nothing was changed in those modules. Frontend Playwright verified data-testids: login-password-toggle, user-password-toggle, jewellery-thumb-{i}-{j}, card-created-on-{id}, card-updated-by-{id}, account-details-richtext, frz-col-1..4. CSS variables --text-muted and --text-secondary resolve to slate-500/slate-700 respectively. .safe-rich-text utility class correctly applies word-break:break-word, overflow-wrap:break-word, max-width:100%.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration's fixes. The image preservation fix correctly uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) on the Pydantic AccountUpdate model to distinguish 'images field not provided by frontend' from 'images explicitly set to []'. Test test_edit_without_sending_images_preserves_them confirms that sending {name, weight} only (no images key) preserves existing images per item by index mapping. The frozen columns CSS uses position:sticky with z-index:16 and explicit background-color to ensure scrolled content doesn't bleed through. Mobile overflow is fixed via .safe-rich-text class which uses word-break:break-word + overflow-wrap:break-word + max-width:100%.
